subject: Emergency surge: temporary capacity package + credit path
messages:
From: Alya Khan <alya@finova.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Finova Platform Team <infra@finova.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Immediate capacity need for Dec 4–8 (surge request)

Hi Mina,

Quick heads-up — our traffic spiked unexpectedly across the settlement pipeline over the weekend. We estimate an additional ~120M tokens between Dec 4–8 for the credit checks workflow. Current quota will definitely be exhausted Monday. Can Redwood provide an emergency surge package (short-window uplift + temporary rate increase) and a credit to cover overrun while we finalize a committed increase?

Two asks: 1) temporary rate cap bump to 3x for up to 7 days, 2) a one-time credit to offset the overrun billing while we sign the change-order. I attached a short PDF with the token forecast and impact.

We’re on a tight Ops cadence — can you confirm by EOD today?

Thanks,
Alya
Senior SRE — Finova
[attachment: Finova-Surge-Request-DEC2026.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alya Khan <alya@finova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Immediate capacity need for Dec 4–8 (surge request)

Hi Alya — thanks for the quick note and the forecast. Sorry to hear about the spike. We can absolutely support a short-window uplift while we sort a longer-term commit.

Proposal (high-level):
- Temporary uplift: 3x rate limit for a 5-day window (Dec 4–8).
- Guardrail: soft throttling above 3x; automated alerting to both teams at 80% of the uplifted quota.
- Billing: charge actual usage at the uplifted rate; Redwood to provide a one-time credit equal to X% of the overrun invoice if Finova agrees to sign a 12-month committed capacity amendment by Dec 31.

I’ve looped Ben and Laura to confirm the credit quantum and the internal approval path. We’ll follow up with a short table (tokens, expected spend, proposed credit percentage) and a DocuSign link if you’re comfortable with the commitment timeline.

Can you confirm the exact token window and whether Finova legal can sign a month-to-month change-order today so we can expedite?

—Mina
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate capacity need for Dec 4–8 (surge request) — credit math

Mina / Laura — I ran numbers based on Alya’s forecast (attached spreadsheet). Rough outline:
- Estimated extra tokens: 120M (4 days of heavy traffic, some tail into day 5).
- At uplifted rate (3x), incremental revenue ≈ $9.6k.
- To be meaningful from a sales perspective, recommend a 40% one-time credit on the incremental overrun if we get a 12-month commit at ~30% discount on committed unit pricing.
- Credit would be applied as invoice adjustment for Dec usage; legal to sign a simple amendment (we can use a standard change-order template).

Operational notes: need infra ops aware of soft throttles; Laura can enable the alerting and confirm the route for burst traffic. Also check if we need a temporary quota policy in the tenant (Laura).

I’ll prepare the DocuSign bundle and the short-term package spreadsheet. Attaching proposed-temp-cap-plan-v2.xlsx.

—Ben
Principal Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed-temp-cap-plan-v2.xlsx]

From: Alya Khan <alya@finova.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Finova Platform Team <infra@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Immediate capacity need for Dec 4–8 (surge request) — approval and next steps

Mina / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the numbers. Finova agrees to the proposed approach: temporary 3x uplift for Dec 4–8, soft throttling at 80%, and the 40% one-time credit applied to the Dec overrun invoice once the 12-month commitment amendment is signed (Finova legal confirmed we can sign the amendment by Dec 31).

Please send the DocuSign package and the final small change-order. We’ll route it internally for signature and aim to return it within 48 hours. Also confirm whether Redwood needs a PO or internal billing contact for the invoice adjustment.

Appreciate the fast help here — this keeps our production pipelines stable during the spike.

Best,
Alya
Senior SRE — Finova
